item.title: No one is happy with NASA's new idea for private space stations
item.description:
📝 NASA proposed a new solution that would bind the private companies more closely to NASA, requiring them not to build free-flying space stations but rather to work directly with the space agency on modules that would, at least initially, dock with the International Space Station. Clarity would only come through the issuance of a “request for proposals” that would lay out specifically what NASA wanted. How much crew space did it need.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/03/what-happens-next-with-nasas-plan-to-replace-the-iss-source-it-could-get-ugly/
